purpose: Consistent pre-M2 production SQLite backup before the campaign's additive schema migrations

backup.method: SQLite online backup API from a read-only source connection; streamed from the serving container and reverified locally

zero_cost_code_rollback.other_configuration: Leave CLAIM_VERIFIER_MODEL unset to inherit MODEL_NAME and global COSCIENTIST_REQUIRE_FREE_MODELS off so ordinary BYOK remains available; campaign requests retain request-scoped zero-cost admission.
zero_cost_code_rollback.eligibility: Recheck current OpenRouter catalog eligibility before live calls. The selected free route is advertised to expire 2026-09-25. This code rejects it after expiry; halt campaign inference until a replacement is qualified. Do not restore old paid or now-unlisted default routes.
zero_cost_code_rollback.data: Keep the additive migration columns and current database when rolling back code. Do not restore this snapshot for an ordinary code rollback.

recovery_note: Keep additive schema columns on code rollback. This backup is for separately justified data recovery, not routine rollback; restoring it would lose later production writes. No private rows are included in this record.
